title: Business Development & Marketing Executive
company: Bright Side Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Do you enjoy sales and want to help an exciting business shape their marketing and commercial relationships not just make calls?

If you are confident with people, commercially minded and creative this could be the Business Development opportunity you have been waiting for.

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an ambitious and driven individual to provide Business Development and Marketing support for an exciting company based near Biggin Hill, Kent.

In this full time, permanent role, you ll combine proactive sales, relationship-building, networking and social media skills, whilst working closely with the Managing Director to grow the business.

What you ll be doing
- Contact prospective clients by phone, email and LinkedIn
- Build relationships with facilities and property managers, managing agents, contractors and commercial decision-makers
- Identify opportunities to arrange and attend client meetings, and occasional site visits
- Attend networking meetings, local business events, and industry exhibitions
- Creative input for social media content, using project photos and videos for engaging before-and-after posts.
- Follow up leads and quotations, maintain relationships and help secure new work.
- Add to and maintain the prospect database and sales pipeline
- Identify additional growth opportunities with the Managing Director

Who we re looking for
- A confident, friendly and comfortable personality to begin conversations and build relationships
- Self-motivated, organised and ready to take ownership
- Resilient when handling rejection, with a positive attitude
- Comfortable using social media and willing to learn new tools
- Commercially minded and interested in business growth
- Able to travel to meetings and events; a full UK driving licence is essential

If you have experience in sales, recruitment, hospitality, estate agency, marketing, customer service or business networking we would like to hear from you!

Specific industry experience is not required. What IS essential is strong communication skills, a friendly personality, a positive attitude and a willingness to learn. These attributes matter more than a perfect CV!

What s on offer?
- Performance-related bonus and the opportunity to increase your earnings
- Hybrid working: Biggin Hill office, home working and external meetings
- A varied role with real influence on a growing business
- Direct access to the Managing Director
- Training, ongoing support and genuine progression opportunities
- A friendly, ambitious team focused on quality and customer service

If you are proactive and enjoy meeting people, we d love to hear from you.

title: Content Manager 4 Day Working Week
description:
KRG are working with an ambitious, award-winning digital marketing agency looking to bring a Content Manager into their growing team. Working with an exciting portfolio of predominantly consumer, lifestyle and travel brands, the agency takes a strategic, customer-first approach to digital marketing. Combining audience insights, behavioural science, creativity and data, they deliver content strategies that build brand visibility, engage audiences and drive commercial results.

With an impressive collection of industry awards and a reputation for putting their people first, this is a great opportunity to join a collaborative agency where creativity, strategic thinking and professional development are genuinely encouraged.

The Role

They're looking for a Content Manager to take ownership of content strategy, planning and delivery across a varied portfolio of client accounts. This is a great mix of strategic thinking and hands-on content, giving you the opportunity to lead content plans, develop creative ideas, oversee production and work closely with a talented, multi-disciplinary team. You'll be responsible for turning audience insights, search data and behavioural trends into engaging content that delivers measurable results.

What you'll be getting stuck into:
- Developing and leading content strategies across a portfolio of predominantly consumer, lifestyle and travel clients, aligned with their wider marketing and commercial objectives.
- Overseeing the end-to-end content process, from research and ideation through to briefing, writing, editing and publishing, while maintaining a hands-on approach to key deliverables.
- Shaping engaging content ideas, maintaining brand tone of voice and ensuring everything produced is accurate, high-quality and audience-focused.
- Building strong client relationships, presenting strategies and recommendations, managing budgets and timelines, and identifying opportunities to grow accounts.
- Working closely with SEO specialists to improve organic visibility, monitor content performance and optimise existing assets, while keeping ahead of AI search and evolving search behaviours.
- Working alongside Digital PR, SEO, Creative and Growth teams to deliver integrated campaigns, while mentoring and supporting junior team members.

What They're Looking For
- Agency-side experience in content marketing (this isn't an SEO Manager role).
- Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience developing content strategies and managing delivery across multiple client accounts.
- Confident client-facing skills, with the ability to present ideas and provide strategic recommendations.
- A good understanding of SEO, search behaviour and content performance.
- Someone commercially minded, creative and curious about emerging content trends and AI tools.

The Package & Perks
- 35k+ salary, depending on experience.
- Flexible working arrangements, including a 4-day working week.
- Hybrid working and a Work Anywhere policy.
- 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays.
- Your birthday off, an additional charity day and Christmas closure between Christmas and New Year.
- Private healthcare through Vitality.
- Weekly wellbeing sessions and access to trained Mental Health First Aiders.
- Breakfast club, healthy snacks and regular Lunch & Learn / Brunch & Learn sessions.
- Internal and external training opportunities.
- Clear opportunities for career progression.
- Additional employee benefits.

title: Office Coordinator Marketing company WFH £24k
description:
Are you an organised, people-focused professional who thrives on keeping everything running smoothly behind the scenes?

We are recruiting for a newly created Office Coordinator position within a growing, fully remote creative business. This is a varied and rewarding role where you'll become the central point of contact for operations, administration, HR coordination, employee engagement, and company events. Working closely with the leadership team, you'll play a key role in maintaining a positive culture across a distributed workforce while ensuring day-to-day operations run efficiently.

Please find all the details below:

Job title: Office Coordinator

Location: Hybrid working with occasional travel to Deal, once every 2 weeks, therefore candidates need to live within a commutable distance to Deal.

Salary: 24,000

Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm

Our client can offer:
- Flexible hybrid working arrangement.
- Friendly and collaborative company culture.
- Opportunity to shape a brand-new role and make a genuine impact.
- Career progression within operations, HR, people management, or events.
- Regular company meet-ups and social events.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.

Your key responsibilities as the Office Coordinator would be:
- Act as the first point of contact for operational and administrative support across the business.
- Manage internal communications and company-wide updates.
- Maintain digital filing systems, business documentation, and shared resources.
- Oversee software subscriptions, licences, equipment allocation, and user access.
- Support senior leadership with diary management, scheduling, and coordination.
- Organise employee recognition initiatives, including birthday celebrations, gifts, vouchers, and client gifting.

HR & Employee Experience:
- Support recruitment administration, including interview scheduling, candidate screening, and reference requests.
- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, including equipment ordering, account set-up, welcome packs, and documentation.
- Maintain HR records, contracts, compliance documentation, and policy updates.
- Track annual leave, absence records, and remote-working compliance.
- Act as a trusted point of contact for employee queries.
- Liaise with external HR consultants to support employee lifecycle processes.

Events & Culture:
- Organise quarterly company meet-ups and team events.
- Research venues, coordinate logistics, manage bookings, and oversee budgets.
- Deliver memorable employee experiences, including annual celebrations and company-wide events.
- Gather feedback and continuously improve future events.

Marketing & Project Coordination:
- Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to coordinate activities and projects.
- Maintain project trackers and marketing schedules.
- Monitor progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and ensure deadlines are met.
- Provide administrative support for campaigns and business initiatives.
- Communicate updates and flag potential delays to stakeholders.

You'll be the ideal candidate for this position if you have the following:
- Experience as an Operations Assistant, Team Coordinator, or similar role.
- Experience working within a remote, fast-paced, or digital environment.
- The ability to combine excellent organisation with a genuine passion for people and culture.
- Experience handling confidential information with discretion.
- Confidence using modern workplace technology, including Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, and project management systems.
- Previous HR administration experience or a good understanding of UK employment processes.
- Experience within a creative, digital, marketing, media, or professional services environment would be advantageous.

The recruitment process will involve:
- An initial video interview
- Face-to-face interview with the hiring manager

Next steps:

If you're looking for a varied position where no two days are the same and you can play a central role in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Alternatively, if you know someone who may be suitable for this role please share the details. If you successfully refer a friend for the above role, you will receive a 100 voucher of your choice! Terms apply

If you do please call us on (phone number removed) ASAP or within 24 hours to discuss the position in further detail with Pippy (Candidate Consultant) or Nicola (Elite Consultant).

title: Part-Time Social Media & Content Creator
description:
Part-Time Social Media & Content Creator
Location: Borough Green, Kent (Office-based)
Hours: Part-time, ideally 20 hours per week across 3-5 days
Salary: 16- 19 per hour (DOE)

About the Role

We're looking for a creative and organised Social Media & Content Creator to manage our social media presence, marketing content and communications. This varied, hands-on role will see you creating engaging content, managing campaigns, producing marketing materials and helping promote the business across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities
Social Media
- Manage social media channels including LinkedIn and Facebook.
- Plan, create, schedule and publish engaging content.
- Maintain a content calendar and monitor engagement.
- Create content around company news, events, customer stories and industry updates.
- Capture photos and content at company activities and events.
- Monitor performance and provide regular reporting.

Content Creation & Design
- Create content for digital and print marketing materials.
- Design graphics, flyers, brochures, adverts and email campaigns.
- Produce and edit basic photography and video content.
- Maintain brand consistency across all communications.

Email Marketing
- Create and manage customer email campaigns.
- Build engaging email content and layouts.
- Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements.
- Manage mailing lists and ensure GDPR compliance.

Digital Marketing
- Support website updates, blogs, case studies and customer communications.
- Promote services, events and business achievements.
- Track engagement and identify opportunities to increase brand awareness.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience managing business social media accounts.
- Strong knowledge of LinkedIn, Facebook and other social platforms.
- Experience creating, scheduling and managing content.
- Email marketing campaign experience.
- Graphic design skills, ideally with Canva and/or Adobe Creative Cloud.
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills.
- Basic photography and photo editing skills.
- Understanding of social media analytics and reporting.
- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of projects.

Desirable
- HubSpot or similar CRM/email marketing platforms.
- WordPress.

title: Senior Digital & Social Marketing Executive
description:
Senior Digital & Social Marketing Executive
35,000 - 40,000 DOE
Full Time, Monday - Friday

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Digital & Social Marketing Executive to join a well-established and growing Kent-based business. This is a varied role offering ownership of digital marketing activity across a portfolio of established brands, with responsibility for social media, website management, content creation, email marketing, SEO and paid digital campaigns.

Working closely with the wider marketing team, you will play a key role in driving brand awareness, customer engagement and online growth through creative, data-driven marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage and optimise company websites, ensuring content is engaging, accurate and SEO-focused.
- Create and deliver social media content and campaigns across multiple platforms to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
- Develop compelling content including blogs, articles, newsletters, emails and website copy.
- Plan, execute and analyse email marketing campaigns, identifying opportunities to improve performance.
- Monitor website, social media and email marketing performance, producing reports, insights and recommendations.
- Support and optimise SEO and paid search activities to improve online visibility, website traffic and return on investment.
- Maintain content calendars and coordinate marketing activity across multiple brands.
- Support the growth of online sales and customer engagement through effective digital marketing initiatives.
- Work closely with internal teams and external agencies to deliver successful marketing campaigns and projects.

This role would suit an experienced digital marketer with strong copywriting skills, experience managing social media channels, website content and email campaigns, and a solid understanding of SEO and digital marketing best practices. Experience using CRM systems, CMS platforms and Adobe Creative Suite would be advantageous.

Benefits Include:
- Hybrid working following probation
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- On-site parking
- Staff discount
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

Apply now for immediate consideration!

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Executive / Senior Digital Marketing Executive

Exec = c£35 K / Senior = £40-£44 K

+ Attractive Benefits Full-Time Hybrid Working (3 days office / 2days WFH)

Diamond Search Recruitment is delighted to be representing our client in the search for a talented Digital Marketing professional to join their established Marketing & Business Development team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established professional services organisation in a varied, hands-on digital marketing role, helping to enhance brand visibility, engage audiences and support wider business development objectives.

There is flexibility to appoint at either Digital Marketing Executive or Senior Digital Marketing Executive level, depending on experience. Senior-level candidates must demonstrate the appropriate depth of experience.

The Role

Working as part of a friendly, collaborative and positive team, you'll take an active role in delivering digital marketing activity across the business. It's a fast-paced environment where people work closely together, share ideas and support one another.

This is very much a hands-on role, offering exposure to a large, established organisation and the opportunity to work with a broad range of internal stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:
- Website & SEO: Managing website content, supporting development projects and SEO.
- Work with digital partner agencies to implement agreed SEO recommendations.
- Social Media: Managing social channels, planning content calendars and creating engaging digital content.
- Video & Content Creation: Producing and editing video, graphics and multimedia content for digital campaigns.
- Email Marketing: Creating, delivering and analysing targeted email marketing campaigns.
- Digital Advertising: Supporting Google, Bing and paid social campaigns, working alongside external agencies.
- Analytics & Reporting: Monitoring performance, analysing results and identifying opportunities to improve engagement and lead generation.

About You

We're looking for a creative, proactive and commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys getting involved, taking ownership and making things happen.

Essential experience and skills:
- Previous digital marketing experience within a professional services environment.
- Experience working within an established, medium-to-large organisation or structured B2 B business, with exposure to multiple stakeholders.
- Strong hands-on experience across website management, social media, email marketing, SEO and digital campaigns.
- Excellent content creation skills, including copywriting, graphic design and video editing.
- Good working knowledge of CMS platforms, Google Analytics, SEO tools and email marketing systems.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva or similar tools.
- Confident working with external agencies and internal stakeholders.
- Highly organised, creative and detail-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

For the Senior Digital Marketing Executive appointment, candidates must demonstrate additional senior-level experience, including ownership of digital activity, campaign delivery and the ability to make recommendations that improve marketing performance.

A marketing degree or professional qualification would be preferred.

What's on Offer?
- Attractive salary range, according to experience level.
- Great benefits package.
- Full-time, hybrid working.
- A positive, supportive and collaborative team culture.
- Opportunity to work within an incredible, highly-reputable professional services organisation.
- A varied, hands-on role with genuine opportunity to make an impact and develop your career.

Interested?

If you have a strong digital marketing background within professional services and enjoy working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can really get involved, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today through Diamond Search Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
description:
Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
Chatham, Kent Type: Permanent
Salary: £25,000 - £35,000
About the Role
The Social Media & Marketing Coordinator will own the day-to-day social media presence of the business, creating engaging content that showcases projects, teams and specialist construction services. This is an excellent opportunity for a creative individual who enjoys content creation, social media marketing and building brand awareness.
This employer delivers specialist construction services across multiple divisions including fire stopping, builders works and specialist contracting activities. They are keen to find someone with energy, creativity and a willingness to develop alongside the business.
What You Will Do
The Social Media & Marketing Coordinator will be responsible for creating engaging content that promotes the company's services and people.
- Create and publish daily social media content across LinkedIn, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Visit operational teams to capture photos, videos and project updates for marketing campaigns.
- Interview employees and produce content showcasing projects, company culture and specialist services.
- Plan and maintain a consistent social media calendar to increase online visibility and engagement.
- Monitor performance metrics and suggest improvements to content strategy and audience growth.
- Work closely with management to generate ideas and promote business achievements across digital channels.

What You Bring (Essential)
- Experience as a Social Media Executive, Social Media Coordinator or Digital Marketing Executive.
- Experience as a Social Media Executive creating content for businesses or commercial organisations.
- Ability to create engaging video, photo and written content for social media platforms.
- Experience managing LinkedIn and at least one additional social media platform.
- Ability to commute to the Dartford area office and visit operational sites when required.
- Strong written communication skills and confidence interacting with employees and managers.

Desirable
- Experience creating TikTok, Instagram Reels or short-form video content.
- Construction, engineering, trades or built environment sector experience.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar content creation tools.
- Marketing qualification or equivalent hands-on industry experience.

What the Employer Offers.
- Creative freedom to help shape the company's online presence.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- Opportunity to work closely with senior management across a diverse business.
